OpenAI.// ChatCompletionsDeployment: Single source of truth for non-prod. Production overrides this via the literal OpenAI__ChatCompletionsDeployment app setting in infra/main.bicep. Must match a live deployment on po-aiservices-shared.

// Google.Imagen3Model: The cost lever for image generation, which is the single largest per-request charge in this app. gemini-2.5-flash-image is the quality default. Cheaper capable alternatives, in order: 'imagen-3.0-fast-generate-001' on Vertex (materially cheaper per image, slightly softer detail), and 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' which has a free tier suitable for local development but hard quota limits that make it unsuitable for production.
// Ollama: Local runtimes, dev only. VisionModel routes image analysis; setting ChatModel additionally moves ALL free-form reasoning (Style Director agents, the Rap Roast scene describer and its lyric writer) off Azure OpenAI onto the local daemon at zero marginal cost. Left empty so nothing changes unless an operator opts in.
// ImageGen: Google Gemini/Imagen is the only image-generation provider. HuggingFace was removed in 2026-08 — its fal-ai routing returned HTTP 400 for every configured model id and the account's inference credits were depleted (402), while every caller silently substituted canned output. This key is retained only so a pre-existing App Service setting cannot fail configuration binding.
